tool_args.rationale: The observations consistently support the shared sink-modulated saturating pool: outputs track u_now and decrease with s_grad, while u_past, x_now, mem_conv, and H do not provide evidence for the competing dynamic mechanisms. Fit the base parameters and compare the documented branch alternatives numerically.

considered_alternatives.option: extra_fine_trajectory_batch for the coupled memory ODE
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All observations have H=0.6, but the supplied siphon signatures and the strong dependence on s_grad identify the static siphon family; the more costly trajectory batch is not justified.
The observed monotone-concave signature and sink-gradient dependence distinguish the siphon mechanism from the slow horizon reversal candidate.
The added open-branch probe informs branch behavior, but fitting and comparing the three documented compact branch forms avoids assuming an unverified branch.
